title: Planning reads the code map: referrers lists a symbol's code references from the pinned map apart from its text mentions
goal: backlog.py referrers TERM reads the code map of this clone's HEAD when one is current, else builds it under _cache; it prints each file that references a symbol in code with kind=ref, from the map's references, apart from each file that only names it in text with kind=text, from the scan it runs now, and --item still marks the files outside the item's scope; the planning skills say to take an item's touches from referrers' kind=ref lines and to read its kind=text lines for docs.
